US reportedly withholds visa for Sudan's Burhan over truce

The United States reportedly withheld a visa for Sudan's army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, according to media reports. The US is reportedly pressuring Burhan to accept a 90-day truce in Sudan's civil war. This action has led to an outcry in Sudan. The US also reportedly blocked a Ugandan delegation. The coverage frames this as a potential use of a 'visa weapon' at the UN.
